benefits.title: Get notified the moment a government changes the rules
benefits.intro: E-invoicing thresholds, wave numbers, and go-live dates change constantly — often with little public notice. Subscribe once, and every government update or announcement across the 29 jurisdictions we track lands in your inbox automatically, in plain language, before it catches your team off guard.

item1.title: Real government announcements, summarised
item1.body: Every new mandate, shifted deadline, and penalty change we track, written in plain language — not legal text copy-pasted from a tax authority's press release.

item2.title: Choose exactly which countries you care about
item2.body: Tell us which of the 29 jurisdictions matter to your business, and your monthly notification email tells you specifically whether they came up — or get the full global digest if you'd rather see everything.

item3.title: A full, searchable back-catalogue
item3.body: Every past issue lives in a searchable, filterable archive — look back at any month, any country, any time, not just whatever landed in your inbox most recently.

item4.title: Priority access to new education content
item4.body: New country deep dives and education guides get flagged to subscribers first, as we publish them.

card.title: Choose your plan
card.sub: One email a month, plus a short alert whenever a new issue covering your countries goes live.
card.planLabel: Choose how you'd like to pay

planRecurring.name: Recurring
planRecurring.desc: Renews automatically each year. Cancel anytime — no need to remember to resubscribe.

planOnetime.name: One-time
planOnetime.desc: Covers 12 months, then simply ends. No auto-renewal, no card kept on file.

form.emailError: A valid email address is required

card.countriesLabel: Which countries do you want alerts for?
card.countriesHint: Optional — leave everything unchecked and we'll send the full monthly digest covering all 29 jurisdictions.
card.countriesMissing: Country selection is temporarily unavailable — you'll still get the full monthly digest. (Missing file: countries.js)
card.fineprint: Payment is handled by Lemon Squeezy, our merchant of record — they collect and remit any applicable VAT/GST on this sale, so you're never charged tax separately. We never see or store your card details. See our privacy policy for how your data is handled.

confirm.title: Confirm & pay
confirm.fineprintRecurring: You'll be taken to a secure Lemon Squeezy checkout window. This plan renews automatically each year until you cancel — you can cancel anytime from the link in your receipt email.
confirm.fineprintOnetime: You'll be taken to a secure Lemon Squeezy checkout window. This is a single payment covering the next 12 months — no card is kept on file and nothing renews automatically.

modal.badge: Real sample issue — not a mockup
modal.fineprint: This is the actual first issue sent to subscribers, exactly as published — nothing edited or shortened for this preview. Every subscriber gets access to the full searchable archive, not just this one issue.
